decision.summary: Visual workspace behavior is covered by Cell-native authority courts rather than copied typed-node runtime tests. The courts prove editable graph-held interaction policy knobs, screen-coordinate marquee selection under pan/zoom/scroll, Shift/Ctrl selection rules, wheel/fit zoom constraints, visible wire hit targets and endpoint rewiring, functional graph-defined Properties tabs, add-parameter/add-interface through one revision-bound interaction endpoint, graph-authored presentation/theme color edits, stable keyed reconciliation, large-canvas performance budgets, graph-authored toolbar/catalog controls, group/ungroup, scope/open-domain navigation, and n-ary relation incidence cables. This slice fixed a real court failure in the browser probe: Add Parameter/Add Interface fixture bindings now declare submitted event-fact sources, and the icon court checks icon-bearing command controls instead of editable data fields.

authority_files.evidence: Browser-DOM probe now declares submitted event-fact sources for relation-form submission fixtures and checks SVG icons only on controls that declare graph icon roots.
Rendered-DOM court covers visible canvas selection, wires, properties, authoring, presentation, catalogue, toolbar, grouping, scope, and relation interaction behavior.
Interaction policy courts prove openable graph-held canvas knobs, browser-ready payload, editable values, invalid-value denial, policy wiring, and real application projection.

Server interaction courts prove one revision-bound interaction endpoint for properties, forms, catalogue placement, openable nodes, inspector lens, deltas, toolbar controls, group/ungroup, and scope-up.
Application-level interaction court proves real Properties tabs execute through one generic graph path.
Cell interaction protocol courts prove events, controls, leases, and event facts are graph-held.
Relation presenter courts prove layered readable relation groups, exact gate/option identity, containment distinction, and live application projections.
Relation security courts prove exposure policy, directionality, receipts, denial, and policy tamper fail-closed behavior.
Relation topology courts prove exact incidence/interface rewiring and invisible participant rejection without partial mutation.
Generic browser runtime exercised by the rendered-DOM courts.
Cell-native interaction policy implementation exercised by the policy courts.
